Alex: Quick plan for a tiny pricing experiment on the launch page  microcalc + FAQ tweak + webinar opt-in. Keep it one-panel.
Mei: Routing idea: tag for sales if est >= $6k OR user checks 'Need contract'. Otherwise enroll in automated webinar drip.
Jordan: UX: two CTAs  'Request a quote' and 'Estimate instantly'. If they pick quote, show 1-field email modal, prefilled when logged in.
Priya: Tier names shortlist: ['Lift','Surge','Anchor'] with 6-word subheads. I prefer Surge for mid.
Sam: Analytics snippet: window.dataLayer.push({event:'pricing_mini',val:est,plan:tier}) and BI buckets: low/mid/high.
LegalBot: Note: any SLA wording must include "subject to standard terms" and link. No uptime absolutes.
OpsBot: Webinar flow: auto-enroll est in [500,5000] if they opt-in; est>5000 triggers sales ping + calendar option.
Alex: Action items: Mei  routing rules; Jordan  quick comps; Priya  finalize names and one-liners; Sam  GTM snippet; LegalBot  snippet. Freeze Thurs EOD.
